decision.smallest_exact_blocker: No governed ARCANA HWR-2 material/thermal parameter tuple or finite authorized intervals exist for k, rho_m, Cp, Tb, T0 and zp, so no finite positive-age ocean flux envelope or justified nonbinding qLim1 can be computed. In addition, 1,072 positive-age ocean cells remain unsupported for the HWR domain because their relationship to 634 unclassified divergent candidates has no governed boundary-process classification.
decision.reason: A complete nonzero heat-flow field cannot be authorized while required ocean support remains unknown, and the HWR-2 ocean values cannot be numerically derived from selected material and thermal parameters.

unknown_cell_facts.support_relation: unique ocean-adjacent support of 634 unselected positive-normal ocean-ocean divergent candidate segments; 3 additional cells overlap selected ridge support and are already in the ridge class
unknown_cell_facts.cause_of_unknown: proximity to other divergent candidates, together with absent boundary_process_class assignments and age-source selection from only one canonical spreading branch
not_the_cause: HWR-2 formula undefined at the cells' strictly positive ages
unknown_cell_facts.authority_assessment: The B-v2 candidate age values are ratified for materialization, but the realization manifest says boundary_process_classes_assigned=false. Existing evidence does not establish whether these other divergent candidates are active spreading/rift boundaries that invalidate the single-source age producer. Proximity alone is not grounds to discard an otherwise governed age; here the unresolved process/source completeness directly affects whether the age is a valid cooling age, so retain UNKNOWN pending classification.

authorized_positive_age_hwr_domain_curre.interpretation: Previously audited positive-age cells after excluding the 1,072 unknowns; not sufficient to close complete ocean support.

support_completeness.zero_policy: UNKNOWN is kept in a separate validity/domain mask and is never serialized as heat-flow zero; OrbData zero has missing/grid-fallback semantics.

qlim1_binding.reason: qLim1 equals the ridge boundary and has no margin. The HWR-2 positive-age maximum and sensitivity envelope are unavailable; a finite nonbinding cap cannot be proven. A placeholder larger cap would be arbitrary. Preserve governed explicit ARCANA heatFl or fail closed on an out-of-envelope value after a future envelope is authorized.

qlim0_dQL_dE_binding.proof: Over E in [-6819.275552157349,3309.49365234375] m, 0 + 0*E = 0 W m-2 exactly. Every authorized continental value (0.045..0.085), ridge value (0.3), and any HWR-2 t>0 value for positive Tb-T0 is >0, so the initial lower clamp does not bind. The later conditional geotherm correction still requires preserve-or-fail-closed behavior; this proof does not claim full Assign pass-through is qualified.
